newsitem.title: USA: U.S. CREDIT MARKET OUTLOOK - Barrage of data lurks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. CREDIT MARKET OUTLOOK - Barrage of data lurks.

text.p: U.S. credit markets this week will contend with a statistical storm that has the potential to wreak havoc across the Treasury yield curve.
The good news is that government bond prices will likely bear the wrath of the data deluge largely unscathed, Wall Street money market experts said.
"If my (forecast) numbers come out to be the case ... it would not change the market tone," said Cheryl Katz, a senior economist at Merrill Lynch & Co Inc.
